disease_label_per_paper: Coexistence of huge venous thromboembolism and bleeding tendency in cytokine release syndrome during CAR-T therapy
presentation_summary: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with extramedullary and CNS involvement treated with sequential CD19- and BCMA-CAR-T cells.
Within 3 days after CAR-T infusion he developed fever, hypotension, hypoxemia, and sinus tachycardia that stabilized with antipyretics, oxygen and fluid replacement.
On day 5-8 he developed recurrent fever, large painful left femoral vein thrombosis, thrombocytopenia, prolonged PT/aPTT, high IL-6 and mixed bleeding/thrombosis risk.
Tocilizumab was given on days 6 and 8; coagulation and CRS indicators improved, no thrombus was detected by day 16, and he was discharged day 30.

clinical_timeline.event: CD19-CAR-T cells infused; BCMA-CAR-T cells followed on D1-D2.
Within three days he developed fever, hypotension, hypoxemia and sinus tachycardia, treated with antipyretics, oxygen and fluid replacement.
Temperature rose to 39 C; left lower extremity swelling and pain with platelet count 25 x 10^9/L; rivaroxaban started.
Swelling worsened; PT 29.4 s, APTT 94.8 s, temperature 39.2 C, IL-6 1180.7 pg/mL; tocilizumab 8 mg/kg given.
IL-6 peaked at 11403.2 pg/mL; second tocilizumab dose given.
Mass shrunk and CSF no longer showed cancer cells; later CNS myeloma relapsed and the patient died after giving up further treatment.

confirmatory_findings.finding: Paper interpreted the event as severe CRS with coagulation disorder
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: serious CRS and coagulation disorder manifested with a huge thrombus in the femoral vein and a bleeding tendency
IL-6 level (11403.2 pg/mL) peaked on D8

outcome.short_term: CRS and coagulation indicators dropped after tocilizumab; no thrombus detected by day 16; discharged day 30.
outcome.oncologic: At day 60 mass had shrunk significantly and CSF no longer showed cancer cells.
outcome.later: Myeloma later relapsed in the CNS; patient died after stopping further therapy for financial reasons.

quality_warnings: Specific CRS diagnosis wording is kept as confirmatory_findings with use_in_ranking:false.
Hypotension and hypoxemia were reported without exact BP/SpO2 values, so no numeric MAP or oxygen saturation was invented.
PT was converted approximately to INR because the current atlas axis is prothrombin_time_inr.
